finding.title: Slot times ignore the venue's time zone
finding.explanation: slotsFor computed the day's start in the server's zone, so a venue east of UTC listed its slots shifted by its offset. On this head the line builds the start in `venue.timeZone`, which may fix it.
finding.reasoningSummary: The cited line changed on the newest head. The reviewer did not verify the new line, so it reads as looking resolved, not resolved.
finding.suggestedFix: Build the start of the day in the venue's zone, as this head now does, and add a test for a venue east of UTC.

evidence.text:
const start = startOfDay(parseISO(`${day}T00:00:00`), { in: tz(venue.timeZone) });
  return venue.openings.map((o) => addMinutes(start, o.minuteOfDay));
